semantic_review: Tracked and Recorded relations preserve full native/generated audit tails. Future-handle guesses are rejected and cannot contribute successful signatures/reveals to later creation; source/generated ownership uses injective allocation indices rather than cryptographic key-byte injectivity.

Known imports remain explicit local known seeds and their audits remain retained; they do not become generated challenger targets. Same-key collisions do not invalidate the formal history mapping or silently create a primitive injectivity assumption.

All primitive service/router cases and complete adaptive continuations are covered. Projecting report monitors preserves the full registry, generated private state and actual result distribution; derived public snapshot equality is used at the reached prefix.

Freshness is exactly absence of successful native seed disclosure at the mapped handle, not an unrevealed-forever restriction. Later source compromise remains possible; existing first-fresh-report stopping remains the event endpoint.

InitializedReports consumes the actual generated-or-imported constructor and complete initialized work. It derives the same-execution source result and immutable attempt ledger through existing exact source erasure; no ledger/history equality is required as an external premise.

AttemptReports.owner_origin retains original immutable KEM slot and all chronological signing attempts, including failed publication. Fixed signed prekey/PQ fields plus accepted tuple outside the ledger imply an original unissued field; native key/history/freshness then instantiate the ordinary FieldOriginFailure event.

The protected generated-owner event still requires an actual mapped handle, literal key match, accepted candidate and native freshness. This does not assume every candidate is honest, and the theorem does not claim an arbitrary supplied candidate was actually submitted to the reporter. Actual raw report detection remains the separate existing batch consumer.

No new oracle work or loss is added by these representation proofs. Inherited generated capacity g+qCreate,3*qBundle signing,qAccept+qFinish converted DH,N*qAccept report attempts and original ambient/runtime/base/KEM bills remain explicit. Explicit identity sum remains; no guessed-field/report-position factor is invented.
limits: Approval concerns source/report representation, not selected KEM/root or global authentication/secrecy
Ordinary endpoint is exact joint Ed25519/X25519 use, not standalone Ed25519 EUF-CMA
Successful source result and protected generated-key prefix are explicit theorem conditions; imported and later-compromised executions remain available
Root imports/inventory reconciliation and subsequent selected KEM/root/event composition remain separate
Read-only review; no new Lean/prover/Rust build or test runs
